caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, standing on four slender, curved legs. The chest is rectangular, primarily colored in shades of brown with a wood grain texture visible on its surface. There are seven drawers, each fitted with two ornate, symmetrical brass handles. The top two drawers are shorter in height compared to the remaining five, which are all of equal, greater height. The legs are designed in a cabriole style, extending outward and then curving inward toward the feet. The base of the chest above the legs features a scalloped decorative edge. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or details present in the composition. There is faint text reading "chest squares" located in the lower left area of the image.
title: High Chest of Drawers on Frame
